sentences.text:
Author: Indrajit Chatterjee
Bench: Indrajit Chatterjee
 1
01-09-16
Ad Item no. 7 C.R.R. No. 3223 of 2012 With Cran No. 3445 of 2016 In re : Pawan Kumar Surana &
Ors. ... Petitioners Mr. Debasish Roy, Mr. Kaushik Gupta, Mr. Anirban Tarafder, Mr. Vivek
Jhunjhunwala.
Mr. Gopal Chandra Das, Mrs. Rituparna Sarkar.

In this application, the petitioners, revisionists, have prayed for extension of the interim order of stay granted by this Court on 21-06-2016 in CRR No. 3223 of 2012 wherein these petitioners, revisionists, have prayed for quashing of Proceeding No. 6D of 2010 now pending before the Municipal Magistrate, 3rd Court at Calcutta, in respect of the offence punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
Heard Mr. Roy, learned Advocate, appearing on behalf of the petitioners and also Mr. Das, learned Advocate, appearing on behalf of the Calcutta Municipal Corporation.
The revisional application is yet to be heard and as such, the stay order granted by this Court earlier be extended till 7th November, 2016.
Thus, the application, being CRAN No. 3445 of 2016, is disposed of accordingly.
Let the revisional application appear at the top of the list as "Contested Application" on that date.
Affidavit-of-service filed in Court today be kept with the record.
Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties on usual undertaking.

(Indrajit Chatterjee, J.)
CRAN-3445-2016 on 1 September, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80582681/
